Which of the following statements are true regarding the function given below?

$$
f(x)=\{\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}, & x\ne 1 \\ 2, & x=1\end{aligned}
$$

I. It is continuous and differentiable at $x=1$

II. It is **not** continuous at $x=1$ but it is differentiable at $x=1$

III. It is **not** differentiable on the interval $x\in (-2,2)$
